description: This file defines a Java interface 'AuthenticationScheme' which specifies a contract for authentication schemes in the OpenMRS project. It declares a method for authenticating credentials and provides licensing and package information.

classes.name: AuthenticationScheme
classes.description: An interface for authentication schemes in OpenMRS, requiring implementation of the 'authenticate' method.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates the given credentials and returns an Authenticated object or throws an exception if authentication fails.
